description: This file defines a singleton object DataMappers with extension functions to convert Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) into domain models ContentItem and TvChannel in a Kotlin-based application.

methods.name: toContentItem
methods.description: Converts ContinueWatchingDto to ContentItem domain model.

methods.name: toTvChannel
methods.description: Converts TvChannelDto to TvChannel domain model, parsing program time window and handling null values.
